relationships.subject: adiponectin
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of adipoR1 by 100 nM adiponectin had a stimulatory effect on Cav3.2 channels but comparatively no effects on either Cav3.1 or Cav3.3 currents

relationships.subject: AdipoR1
relationships.evidence_quote: Coimmunoprecipitation analysis of mouse TGs showed that CK2 α-subunits interacted with adipoR1

relationships.subject: CK2alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: 100 nM adiponectin robustly enhanced PKC activity; this effect was abrogated by CK2α-siRNA pretreatment

relationships.subject: adiponectin
relationships.evidence_quote: adiponectin at 100 nM clearly induced PKCβ1 recruitment to the membrane of the soma

key_findings: Adiponectin stimulates TG Cav3.2 via AdipoR1, CK2alpha-dependent PKCbeta1, independent of G proteins, causing hyperexcitability and pain hypersensitivity
CaMKII and PKA are not involved in the adiponectin-induced T-type current increase
